note: Static tables exported once from the internal accepted-evaluation tables by a one-off export script (not shipped). Storage paths were removed; checkpoint and summary identities are kept as sha256 values.

source.description: Internal accepted canonical V2 evaluation table (not shipped; v2 evaluator, revisions r2, r3, r4)
Internal accepted timestep evaluation table (not shipped; v2 evaluator, revision t1)
Internal accepted C3-from-C1 evaluation table (not shipped; v2 evaluator, C3 action-sensitivity protocol)

caveat_source.description: Internal per-run release table (not shipped); used only for caveats and checkpoint_replaced

derived_column_rules.line: constant per table: canonical_v2, timestep or c3_from_c1
derived_column_rules.variant: source column in the C3 table; empty in the other tables
derived_column_rules.unique_key: source unique_key; in the C3 table the probe segment action_dynamics is replaced by c3_from_c1 and the source key is kept as c1_unique_key
derived_column_rules.timestep: parsed from unique_key (t749 placeholder for encoders and Qwen, t250 for lingbot and minimax_h3 in the canonical table)
derived_column_rules.split_id: canonical_v2, or canonical_v2_minimax_owner_subset_r2 for scope canonical_v2_minimax_all_layers_20261011
derived_column_rules.eval_revision: source column for canonical_v2; constant 't1' (timestep) and 'c3' (C3) otherwise
derived_column_rules.ckpt_epoch: parsed from the checkpoint file name epoch=E-step=S.ckpt
derived_column_rules.ckpt_step: parsed from the checkpoint file name epoch=E-step=S.ckpt
derived_column_rules.train_batch_size_inferred: unique B in {1,2,3,4,6,8} with floor(N_train/B)*(ckpt_epoch+1) == ckpt_step; N_train 2445, or 1523 for the MiniMax all-layers owner subset
derived_column_rules.checkpoint_replaced: from the internal per-run release table: true when an fp32 retrain replaced a checkpoint with non-finite weights
derived_column_rules.summary_file: basename of the evaluator summary JSON
derived_column_rules.caveats: from the internal per-run release table (B2_SCORED_x_OF_y renamed HIDDEN_OBJECT_SCORED_x_OF_y), plus C1_TRAINED_AND_EVALUATED_H1_ONLY, C3_SAME_TRAJECTORY_ENDPOINTS_NOT_COUNTERFACTUAL and H1_TRAINED_NOT_PROTOCOL_C3; C3 rows inherit the caveats of their C1 run except REPORT_WITH_NO_ACTION_SHUFFLED_COPY_LAST_CONTROLS and C1_TRAINED_AND_EVALUATED_H1_ONLY, which H1_TRAINED_NOT_PROTOCOL_C3 replaces
derived_column_rules.c1_unique_key: C3 table only: unique_key of the evaluated C1 (action_dynamics) row in canonical_v2_val_seed42.csv or timestep_val_seed42.csv
